requirements.text: When the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) of the interdependent lamp(s) shall be deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, for direction indicator lamps the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), except that this does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). This does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, the requirement to return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: If the value of 0.15 per cent is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or alternatively the requirements of paragraph 5.21.2. shall be met.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Where rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are installed, the intensity of all the lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.quote: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: Where rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are installed, in the entire intensity range the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.quote: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: The lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, all lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: Where a light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4, except that the reversing lamp is optional on trailers of category O1.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm, one reversing lamp device shall be fitted, and a second device is optional.
requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle, except that, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp device is installed at the rear of the vehicle, the reversing lamp shall have a geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Rearwards

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: If either of the above conditions is not satisfied, the reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be present on all categories of vehicles (mandatory).
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 category shall be present on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles (mandatory), except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; on other categories of vehicles the devices of S3 or S4 category are optional.
requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices, the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, except that in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle. However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: In the case where one S3 or S4 category stop lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional stop lamps are installed, the optional stop lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 categories stop lamp devices, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall: either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category stop lamp device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.
requirements.quote: However, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 categories stop lamp devices shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle;

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 categories stop lamp devices shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: When the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H, all stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be present as a mandatory device of R or R1 or R2 categories.
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two in number, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in width such that that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement; For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional rear position lamps are installed, the optional rear position lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above is applied at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above is applied and a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above is applied, the rear position lamp shall, to be considered visible, provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, and the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres. The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have electrical connections in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale, which shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: If required by the component Regulation, the rear position lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is installed on trailers, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: Provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, optional on trailers.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: Where additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below) are fitted, the additional retro-reflecting devices and materials shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement; For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground, except that the maximum height may be not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), and 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.text: When an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall (a) specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval of the ESA shall be granted.
requirements.quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.

requirements.text: When an ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.

requirements.text: The approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: The international approval mark affixed on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.text: The international approval mark affixed on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.

requirements.text: The vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
requirements.quote: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.

requirements.text: Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.
requirements.quote: Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.

requirements.text: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system.
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

requirements.text: The test conditions shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-4 BCI, the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-4 BCI the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, the vehicle representative of its type shall have no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6, in order to be considered as complying with immunity requirements.
requirements.quote: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband type approval limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband type approval limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA narrowband type approval limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall not exceed the maximum allowed pulse amplitude given in Table 1, namely +75 V positive and -100 V negative for vehicles with 12 V systems, and +150 V positive and -450 V negative for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.quote: Table 1 Maximum allowed pulse amplitude Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V Negative -100 V -450 V

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a (Stripline 20 to 400 MHz: 60 V/m; TEM cell 20 to 200 MHz: 75 V/m; BCI 20 to 400 MHz: 60 mA; ALSE 80 to 2,000 MHz: 30 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz: 10 V/m; Reverberation chamber LUF to 2,000 MHz: 21 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz: 7 V/m).
requirements.quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested with the test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b (Stripline 20 to 400 MHz: 50 V/m; TEM cell 20 to 200 MHz: 62,5 V/m; BCI 20 to 400 MHz: 50 mA; ALSE 80 to 2,000 MHz: 25 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz: 8 V/m; Reverberation chamber LUF to 2,000 MHz: 18 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz: 6 V/m).
requirements.quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall show no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" in order to be considered as complying with immunity requirements.
requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

requirements.text: The starting profile of the ESA shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1, with immunity test level II (12 V system) and II (24 V system), 10 pulses, and functional status classification B (related to immunity related functions, for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) or C (for other ESA) and D (not related to immunity related functions) as given in Table 3a.
requirements.quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the ESA for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, with the immunity test levels, test duration / number of pulses and FPSC given in Table 3b (pulse 1: -75 V / -450 V, 500 pulses, III / III; pulse 2a: +37 V / +37 V, 500 pulses, I / III; pulse 2b: +10 V / +20 V, 10 pulses, II / III; pulse 3a: -112 V / -150 V, 1 h, I / III; pulse 3b: +75 V / +150 V, 1 h, I / III).
requirements.quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: Where the ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the starting profile shall be applicable to the ESA.
requirements.quote: Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.

requirements.text: Where the ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.

requirements.text: Where the ESA has no immunity related functions, the ESA need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the ESA is not switched, contains no switches or does not include inductive load, the ESA need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test of broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according CISPR 25.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.

requirements.text: Where the ESA is involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the ESA shall be in charging mode.
requirements.quote: ESAs involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be in charging mode.

requirements.text: The limits for radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation for the immunity test of the ESA shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: The test signal modulation shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges. regulations.rationale: Consolidated Light-Signalling Devices regulation (combining R7 and R23) under which the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp of this module are type-approved (photometry, colorimetry, lens/material tests). (lexical: term match score 9.2)
Consolidated Retro-Reflective Devices regulation (replacing R3) covering the Class IA/IB retro-reflector integrated in the rear lamp. (lexical: term match score 4.4)

Installation regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices on M1 vehicles; defines positioning, visibility angles, electrical connections and tell-tales for rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors. (lexical: term match score 29.8)
The lamp contains LED modules on PCB (electrical/electronic sub-assembly); EMC emission/immunity requirements apply to the ESA fitted to M1 vehicles. (lexical: term match score 8.9)
Legacy reversing lamp regulation; superseded by consolidated UN R148 which covers reversing lamps. (lexical: term match score 1.2; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Legacy regulation for rear position and stop lamps; superseded by consolidated UN R148 which now covers these functions. (lexical: term match score 1.2; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

Legacy retro-reflector device regulation; the retro-reflector in this module is now approved under the consolidated UN R150, which supersedes R3. (lexical: term match score 0.4; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

Applies to standardised replaceable LED light sources; the module uses LED modules on PCB (non-replaceable light sources approved as part of the lamp under R148), so R128 would only apply if standardised R128 LED categories were used. (lexical: term match score 0.4)
Vehicle-level external projection requirements for M1; assessed on the complete vehicle, not a requirement the lamp component itself must be approved against. (lexical: term match score 0.4)
Rear fog lamps are not included in this module. (lexical: term match score 0.4; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Direction indicators are not part of this module (position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector only). (lexical: term match score 0.1; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Safety glazing explicitly excludes glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices (the outer lens). (lexical: term match score 4.8)
Lighting installation for L3 motorcycles; product is for M1 vehicles. (lexical: term match score 0.9)
Filament light sources; the module uses LED modules, not replaceable filament lamps. (lexical: term match score 0.0)

profile.product: Rear lamp — exterior lighting & signalling module combining rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, outer lens and retro-reflector in a single housing
functions: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility) — rear position lamp, 4 to 17 cd on axis
Braking indication — stop lamp, 60 to 185 cd on axis
Reversing illumination — reversing lamp, visible to 45° outboard
Passive conspicuity — retro-reflector, reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence
Light transmission & colour definition — outer lens, red within chromaticity limits
Sealing against water ingress — seal/gasket, spray test
Retention of lamp aim under vibration — fasteners/clips
materials: Reflector surface: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
Light source: LED modules on PCB
Fasteners / clips: PA, POM, or steel
